relations: As hands press and rotate the dough against the table, its surface smooths toward a round boule.
Fingers folding the dough edge inward cause the lump to gather into a tighter spherical shape.
Contact between palms and dough transfers gentle pressure, deforming the mass while it rests on the wood.
Scattered flour on the table persists as the dough surface becomes taut and even.
caption: Hands shape a lump of clay-like bread dough into a smooth, round boule on a wooden table.
